- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Burj Khalifa is the tallest building in the world with observation decks on the 124th and 125th floors.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Dubai Mall is one of the largest shopping malls in the world with over 1,200 stores, ice skating rinks, cinemas, and virtual reality parks.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Palm Jumeirah is a man-made island in the shape of a palm tree, home to luxury hotels and beaches.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Dubai Miracle Garden features over 45 million flowers arranged in stunning designs.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Dubai Museum showcases the city's history and heritage, located in a historic fort.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended restaurants near Burj Khalifa include At.mosphere, Armani/Ristorante, The Cheesecake Factory, Eataly, Five Guys, Zaytinya, Sakura, and Rivington Grill.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Dubai Mall has movie theaters including Reel Cinemas and VOX Cinemas.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Dubai Ice Rink is an Olympic-sized ice skating rink in the Dubai Mall.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] SEGA Republic is an indoor theme park in the Dubai Mall.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] KidZania is a mini-city designed for kids in the Dubai Mall.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] VR Park is a virtual reality theme park in the Dubai Mall.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Dubai Aquarium and Underwater Zoo is located inside the Dubai Mall.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Hysteria is a haunted house attraction in the Dubai Mall.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Taxi rides in Dubai typically accept credit cards, but it's advisable to confirm with the driver.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Taxi ride from Burj Khalifa to Dubai Museum takes around 10-15 minutes and costs approximately AED 20-30.
